{{Short description|none}}
This article lists some properties of [[Set (mathematics)|sets]] of [[real number]]s. The general study of these concepts forms [[descriptive set theory]], which has a rather different emphasis from [[general topology]].

==Definability properties==
* [[Borel set]] [[Talk:Borel set| ]]
* [[Analytic set]] [[Talk:Analytic set| ]]
* [[C-measurable set]] [[Talk:C-measurable set| ]]
* [[Projective set]] [[Talk:Projective set| ]]
* [[Inductive set]] [[Talk:Inductive set| ]]
* [[Infinity-Borel set]] [[Talk:Infinity-Borel set| ]]
* [[Suslin set]] [[Talk:Suslin set| ]]
* [[Homogeneously Suslin set]] [[Talk:Homogeneously Suslin set| ]]
* [[Weakly homogeneously Suslin set]] [[Talk:Weakly homogeneously Suslin set| ]]
* [[Set of uniqueness]]

==Regularity properties==
* [[Property of Baire]] [[Talk:Property of Baire| ]]
* [[Lebesgue measurable]] [[Talk:Lebesgue measurable| ]]
* [[Universally measurable set]] [[Talk:Universally measurable set| ]]
* [[Perfect set property]] [[Talk:Perfect set property| ]]
* [[Universally Baire set]] [[Talk:Universally Baire set| ]]

==Largeness and smallness properties==
* [[Meager set]] [[Talk:Meager set| ]]
* Comeager set - A comeager set is one whose complement is meager.
* [[Null set]] [[Talk:Null set| ]]
* [[Conull set]] [[Talk:Conull set| ]]
* [[Dense set]] [[Talk:Dense set| ]]
* [[Nowhere dense set]]
